name: Console Application Developer
description: Build command-line tools, scripts, and terminal applications using Dictum's natural-language syntax. Master printing, variables, arithmetic, conditionals, loops, arrays, functions, and structs.
example_snippet:
program Calculator:
    action add takes A as whole number, B as whole number produces whole number:
        produce success with the sum of A and B
    end action

    keep Result as whole number
    call add with 5 and 3 giving Result
    print the text "5 + 3 = " and Result and newline
end program
